description: Madagascar - Tropical Cyclone Gezani - OpenStreetMap Data is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). This dataset contains OpenStreetMap data exported from the HOTOSM disaster mapping response to Tropical Cyclone Gezani in early 2026 (GLIDE: TC-2026-000015-MDG ). On Tuesday the 10th of February, Tropical Cyclone GEZANI 26 made landfall near the city of Toamasina on the eastern coast of Madagascar as Category 4 cyclone. Coverage: Madagascar. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, natural disasters, roads. It offers 4 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
